options.name: core
options.description: The host agent of one hosting machine.

settings.name: stateDir
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_HOST_STATE_DIR: The directory the host key (mode 0600), the enrolment and the placements are kept in.

settings.name: channelUrl
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_HOST_CHANNEL_URL: The platform agent channel the host enrols over (the enrolment answer names the one used after).

settings.name: machineName
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_HOST_MACHINE_NAME: The machine name the host enrols with (a DNS label).

settings.name: meshAddress
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_HOST_MESH_ADDRESS: The machine mesh address the platform reaches the hosted clusters API servers at.

settings.name: hiveSlots
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_HOST_HIVE_SLOTS: How many Hosted hives the machine holds at most.

settings.name: portRange
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_HOST_PORT_RANGE: The API-server ports the clusters bind on 127.0.0.1, <first>-<last>.

settings.name: enrolmentCode
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_HOST_ENROLMENT_CODE_FILE: The one-time host enrolment code from the platform admin console (read once, before enrolment).

settings.name: trustRootFile
settings.description: PRAGMATIC_HOST_TRUST_ROOT_FILE: The pinned platform signing key (public, PEM) the enrolment answer must be signed by.
